answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money — sparingly and against verified performance — so Sybil inflation is filtered before it compounds. Picture a copper field, a mesa in flight, a meadow in the distance — a natural triad mirroring how layered signals resist a single-point forgery.
